title: Bounded attributable long-repository probes
failure_signature: A composite startup or file-inspection wrapper exceeds its time envelope and withholds otherwise independent results.
trigger_preconditions: A Git, task-title, version, or file probe may take longer than a short composite wrapper.
candidate_workaround: Split independent surfaces, use cheap ref checks before clean-state checks, and give each attributable command one adequate bounded envelope.
recurrence_guard: Never aggregate a long Git status or remote query with task-list and version operations whose results would be lost together.
rollback: Give each timed-out wrapper zero evidence credit and inspect state before issuing a narrower probe.
scope_boundary: Read-only workflow recovery only; no phase, scientific, authority, production, or routing credit beyond the observed probes.
